text:
sam: quick heads-up — PR #14321 needs to land before the maintenance freeze at 02/28 00:00 UTC. it's a small DB migration and a couple of config toggles. can someone help expedite reviews?

jess: @sam i'm free in ~30m, can take a pass. any known CI flakes? :eyes:

sam: thanks! test flake on `integration/payment_flow_test` — CI failed once, rerun looks green locally. ci-bot says queued due to backpressure.

matt: pinging @ci-bot — is this on a hot requeue path or stuck behind a long matrix?

ci-bot: ci-bot: Your rerun for PR #14321 is in position 14 of the queue. Estimated start ~45m. Priority: standard.

sam: ugh — freeze window is tight. is there any way to get a canary slot or manual run?

priya: we can try manual rerun on the integration runner (limited quota). @alia do we have spare runner time?

alia: can spare one runner for a quick manual job. sam, paste the `bazel` command you used and i'll kick it off.

sam: thanks! command was `bazel test //service/payment:integration_test --test_tag_filters=-flaky` — I also have a short repro in a gist if needed.

alia: kicked off manual run on runner-03 — logs: https://ci.internal/runs/8421 — looks like the flaky assertion is timing-related, increased timeout fixed it locally.

jess: reviewed the PR, left one nit about a log message, otherwise LGTM. @matt can you approve infra change?

matt: taking a quick look now. if tests pass on manual runner i'll approve and we can request an expedited merge slot.

ci-bot: ci-bot: Manual run completed — all tests passed.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder — merge freeze starts 1717609200 (02/28 00:00 UTC). Merges requested after freeze must go through on-call.

matt: approved. @sam i can trigger the merge but will hold until we coordinate with release ops for a short pre-freeze slot. who from release ops is on today?

sam: @priya can you flag release-ops? we only need the short slot and a canary afterwards.

priya: looping in release-ops channel. if we can land within the next 40m i'll request a pre-freeze window. please keep the migration reversible. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks everyone — will update the PR with the timeout tweak and the revert plan. appreciate the quick help. :pray:

jess: :rocket: good luck, ping here once merge is scheduled.
